name: Pulumi Cloud API
tagline: REST API for Pulumi Cloud stacks, updates, deployments, and org management
description: Pulumi Cloud's REST API for Infrastructure as Code state and organization management. Manage stacks, deployments, updates, secrets, and org resources programmatically—an alternative to Terraform Cloud for teams using Pulumi as code.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header (also accept Bearer). Create tokens in Pulumi Cloud account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Individual free tier available; API rate limits and cloud feature quotas vary by plan—see pricing page for current limits
pricing.paid_plans: Team, Enterprise, and Business Critical plans with higher quotas

use_cases: list stacks in a Pulumi organization
get latest update status for a stack
trigger or inspect a stack deployment
export or inspect stack state programmatically
